## Open the app

[**anayana.github.io/baum/**](/baum/)

Works in any modern mobile browser. Add it to the home screen to keep it one tap away.

## If the app will not start

Browsers keep things for a web app – stored data, cached files, background
workers – and now and then one of those gets in the way. This page repairs
that, and it is deliberately outside the app so that it still works when the
app does not:

[**anayana.github.io/vta-repair.html**](/vta-repair.html)

It does three things, in this order:

1. **Save the data** – everything the browser holds for the app (register, field
   records, photographs, users, log) as one file. This works even when the app
   itself will not start. Do this first.
2. **Repair** – throws away the stored programme copy and reloads. It does not
   touch the saved data.
3. **Restore** – reads a saved file back in, photographs included.

Worth writing down or bookmarking **before** it is needed.

## About

A visual tree assessment is a walk, a look and a judgement, and the record of it
is what anybody else ever sees. VTA Field does that record in the field, on a
phone, without a connection to anything:

- **AR** – markers on the trees through the camera, the diameter measured off the
  stem, defects pinned to the trunk at a height and a bearing, and last year's
  photograph laid over this year's bark from the same standpoint.
- **The register** – imported from a municipal service or a file, in its own
  columns, with the field names matched automatically and corrected by hand.
- **The record** – the fields of the standard in use (FLL, ÖNORM, VSSG and
  others), by hand or by voice, in five languages.
- **Reports** – a letter head, the client's own column layout read from their
  blank form, a drawn signature, and output as a printable page, Word or CSV.
- **Map sheets** – printed at a chosen scale over as many sheets as that scale
  needs, rather than a whole job squeezed illegibly onto one page.

Data stays on the phone. Nothing is uploaded anywhere unless a button is pressed.
